title: WHERE: filter rows like a pro
why_it_matters: Almost every useful query has a WHERE clause.
explanation: WHERE keeps only rows that match a condition. Combine conditions with and, or. Text values go in single quotes, never double quotes. Use = for equals, since SQL uses one equals sign, not two.
code:
select title
from posts
where published = true
  and views > 100;
try_it: Write a query for posts with fewer than 10 views.
